verdict.rationale: The evidence shows screening against a global database of sanctions, watchlists, PEPs and adverse media, plus a configurable risk-score equation. Neither is a cross-merchant consortium signal where a card or identity seen at other businesses informs your risk decision. Nothing in the pack documents shared network intelligence across ComplyAdvantage clients, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a founder, scoring benefits from a cross-merchant network — a card or identity seen across thousands of other businesses informs the risk decision on mine
